title_vi: Đại Kết Cục, BL∞, UNKNOWN và Cứu Cánh của Trí Tuệ
title_en: Grand Ending, BL Infinity, UNKNOWN and Cosmic Optionality
central_thesis: An infinite universe can remain generatively weak if its states live inside a fixed basis and trajectories converge toward low-optionality attractors. BL Infinity distinguishes fixed infinity from open-ended B Infinity, where the generative basis itself can evolve. UNKNOWN is the contact frontier through which intelligence detects and generates new representations, GiaTai, ontologies, capabilities and reachable actuality. Life, intelligence and cooperation may therefore act as counter-pressure against terminal convergence.

fixed_vs_b_infinity.fixed_infinity: infinite states inside fixed primitives, relations and rules
fixed_vs_b_infinity.b_infinity: open evolution of primitives, relations, ontologies, agents, rules, construction paths and the generative basis itself

cosmic_optionality_functional.risk_condition: persistent dV/dt<0 + shrinking escape routes + GenerativeBasisGrowth->0 => GrandEndingRisk

variables.Agency: capacity to select and execute state change
variables.EpistemicDiversity: independence of world-models and blind spots
variables.UnknownFrontierCapacity: ability to detect, bear and transform UNKNOWN
variables.GenerativeBasisGrowth: rate of useful new primitives, relations, ontologies, tools or rules
variables.IrreversibleHomogenization: pressure toward fewer usable gradients, distinctions and reversibility

counter_pressure.life: turn usable gradients into organization, sensing and adaptation
counter_pressure.intelligence: turn gradients plus models plus UNKNOWN plus GiaTai into controlled transformation
counter_pressure.cooperation: combine diverse world-models without collapsing all blind spots into one
counter_pressure.bl_infinity: keep the generative basis open to evolution

core_propositions.text: Infinity is not equivalent to energy, agency or generative power.
Time is not an energy source.
A fixed infinite state-space can remain low-generativity.
B Infinity concerns evolution of the generative basis itself.
UNKNOWN is a contact frontier with BL Infinity openness.
GiaTai and imagination can transform UNKNOWN into candidate structures.
Not actualized is not equivalent to impossible.
Intelligence is a superstructure including ontology mutation and cooperation.
Cooperation and diversity can defend against correlated blind spots.
Life and intelligence may counter loss of optionality through model-based construction.
Grand Ending can be modeled as a low-generativity attractor class.
UnknownFrontierCapacity and GenerativeBasisGrowth are central long-horizon variables in the BL Infinity model.

critique_surface: External critique should target explicit premises, relations, functional variables, measurements, counterexamples or empirical interfaces. The public thesis is stated in its strongest internally coherent form rather than pre-emptively self-negating every proposition.
